transcript_only_text:
The  simplest  path  to  making  money:  1. 
 Find  a  service  people  already  buy.  2.  Do 
 it  in  half  the  time,  make  it  twice  as 
 easy,  or  remove  all  the  risk.  3.  Ask 
 everyone  you  know  if  they  know  anybody 
 who  wants  it.  4.  Charge  more  than 
 everyone  else.  And  then  5.  Don't  stop 
 when  you  get  bored.
